rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when singling out a person or thing for emphasis.

example.english: I like lots of food, especially seafood.
example.traditional: 我鍾意食好多嘢，特別係海鮮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 hou2 do1 je5 dak6 bit6 hai6 hoi2 sin1

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when saying that something is not particularly or especially so.

example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 m4 hai6 dak6 bit6 hou2 tai2
